scenes.text: This tutorial covers Align and Stitch. Register image tiles and build a stitched mosaic incrementally without holding the entire canvas in memory.
Open Align and Stitch from the Data and batch runs section. Choose tiled acquisitions, stage coordinates or overlap metadata, channels, and a destination.
In the main configuration area, configure registration method, reference channel, overlap, blending, correction, chunk size, and output format.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. inspect pairwise alignment and seam previews before building the full mosaic.
When the workflow finishes, registered tiles, stitched images, transforms, and mapping metadata are saved.
